content.text:
I submitted **index 0 (Sb fraction 0.220)** as the best composition. At EQE = 0.343%, it's the highest I measured. I used all 5 EQE measurements and 2 of the 5 XRD measurements.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.220 | **0.343** |
| 1 | 0.236 | 0.287 |
| 4 | 0.303 | 0.191 |
| 15 | 0.654 | 0.031 |
| 22 | 0.800 | 0.027 |

- **Trend:** EQE drops steadily as the Sb fraction rises, and it's close to zero near ZnSb₂O₆ (Sb 0.667) and above.
- **Structure:** Indices 0 and 4 have nearly identical XRD patterns, so there's no phase change between them to create a peak in that range. The closest match was the trirutile ZnSb₂O₆ reference, but only at 0.56 similarity, so I haven't firmly identified the phase.
- **What I skipped:** The Gaussian-process tool suggested measuring the mid-range (Sb about 0.45). It picked that area only because nothing had been measured there, and its predicted EQE was close to zero. I spent the last measurement on index 1 instead, to check the low-Sb end.

One caveat: index 0 is the lowest Sb fraction on the line, so the true maximum could be at an even lower Sb fraction that this library doesn't include.
